credits.overview: Ex-army chief created a secret Force to save the nation from Terror attacks. GREEN FORCE is an unofficial team of Patriots which fight against every terrorist activities.

credits.overview: Its a story of a lost child who want to go home back but he forgot everything , a girl tourist comes from mumbai and try to get reach him home but not succeed.

credits.overview: Father-song duo Shilendra and Satyendra Yadav mastermind a train robbery; among other crimes that they commit together to attain political power and maintain their reign as terrorizers in a small town in Jharkhand, get nabbed by the Kolkata Police on international soil.

credits.title: Gangster vs State
credits.overview: Gangster vs State is a movie directed by Alam Gahir	featuring Mantej Maan, Sunakshi Sharma.

credits.title: Luv Shuv Pyar Vyar
credits.overview: Rahul, a prizefighter who hails from a poor family, is smitten with Ruby, the daughter of a rich and powerful man. While their love blooms, her father opposes their union fiercely.

credits.title: Dhara 302
credits.overview: Dhara 302 is a story about a young lad Veer Singh who accidentally walks on the path of crime from the age of 12. Circumstances force him to continue walking on this path and he ends up becoming a bigger criminal. However, his lady loves Kalpana makes him choose the right path. But does he manage to live a happy life?

credits.title: How Is Wow
credits.overview: Banshi and Purniya decide to take a loan in order to earn quick money. However, their life takes a turn when they are required to pay the debt.

credits.title: Beyond The Third Kind
credits.overview: A young person transitions into a lady-boy, grappling with the trauma and emotional struggles caused by society's harsh treatment of those who don't conform to traditional gender identities.
